summary: Walks a linked list whose head is stored at this+0x1A0 and whose node structs hold a data pointer at +0, a next pointer at +4, and a byte flag at +8. For each node, if the byte flag at +8 is zero the node's data pointer is freed via FreeWrapper_7bcf; every node itself is freed via FreeWrapper_7bcf. After traversal the four list-management fields this+0x1A0..0x1AC are zeroed. Returns the value produced by the last FreeWrapper_7bcf call (or an indeterminate leftover when the loop never runs). Invoked by LinkedListDestructorWithConditionalCleanup (00418df0).

local_names.this: list container holding management fields at this+0x1A0..0x1AC
local_names.i: current node pointer; seeded from head this+0x1A0 and advanced via node+4 next pointer
local_names.v3: aliased current node pointer passed to FreeWrapper_7bcf
local_names.v4: flag test result: byte at node+8 == 0

operations.description: Seed loop counter i with the list head at this+0x1A0.
For-loop over linked-list nodes: continuation test on current node i; the loop increment is result = FreeWrapper_7bcf(v3), freeing each node after its data cleanup.
Guard fact: list is empty when the list count field at this+0x1A8 is 0; the traversal starts from the head at this+0x1A0.
Advance to the next node by reading the next pointer at node offset +4 (this[104]+4, i.e. field *(this+0x1A4)+4).
Read the byte flag at node+8 and test whether it equals 0 (v4); a non-zero flag gates the data-pointer free.
If the flag at node+8 is non-zero and the node's data pointer at +0 is non-null, free the data pointer via FreeWrapper_7bcf(*v3).
Free the node itself via FreeWrapper_7bcf(v3); the return value becomes the loop result.
Zero this+0x1A8 (list count/size field) after traversal.
Zero this+0x1AC (auxiliary list field) after traversal.
Return the value of the last FreeWrapper_7bcf call recorded in result.
Invoked by LinkedListDestructorWithConditionalCleanup (00418df0) as the standalone list cleanup path.
